The URL prefix is the base URL of the API of the server, with or without a \ final slash: with the prefix https://example.com/v1, the application uses \ https://example.com/v1/chat/completions and https://example.com/v1/embeddings, and the connection test \ https://example.com/v1/models. llm.config.name=Server Name llm.config.url=URL prefix llm.config.token=Token llm.config.configfile=Chat models llm.config.embeddingModels=Embedding models llm.config.delete=Delete llm.config.requestmode=Can Stream llm.config.groups=Group Allowed llm.config.test=Connection test llm.config.test.hint=The Test button checks the saved URL prefix and token of a server by requesting its list of models. \ Save your changes before testing them. llm.config.test.button=Test llm.config.test.server={0}: llm.config.test.testing=Testing the connection... llm.config.test.error=The test could not be performed. Check the token. llm.config.test.outcome.NOT_FOUND=The server has no list of models at the URL prefix (HTTP 404). Check the URL \ prefix: it usually ends with /v1. llm.config.test.outcome.HTTP_ERROR=The server answered with the error status HTTP {1}. Check the URL prefix and the \ logs of the AI server. llm.config.test.outcome.INVALID_RESPONSE=The server answered, but not with an OpenAI-compatible list of models. \ Check the URL prefix. llm.config.test.outcome.UNREACHABLE=The server could not be reached. Check the host name and the port in the URL \ prefix, and that the server runs and accepts connections from the wiki server. llm.config.test.outcome.TIMEOUT=The server did not answer in time. Check the URL prefix and that the server runs. llm.config.test.outcome.TLS_ERROR=The secure connection to the server failed. Check that the URL prefix uses the \ right protocol (http or https) and that the wiki server trusts the certificate of the AI server. llm.config.test.outcome.INVALID_URL=The URL prefix is missing or invalid. Enter an absolute URL such as \ https://api.openai.com/v1/. llm.config.test.outcome.INVALID_TOKEN=The token contains characters that cannot be sent to the server, such as a \ line break or an invisible character copied along with it. Enter the token again. llm.config.test.outcome.CONNECTION_ERROR=The connection to the server failed. Check the URL prefix and the network \ connection of the wiki server. llm.config.test.outcome.FORBIDDEN=Only wiki administrators can test the AI server configurations. llm.config.test.outcome.INVALID_FORM_TOKEN=The test was refused because the form token is invalid or expired. \ Reload the page and try again. llm.config.test.outcome.UNKNOWN_SERVER=There is no saved server configuration with this name.
